pages.title: §lMaterial Categories
pages.text: Enchanting materials are divided into two categories:$(br2)§l1. Universal Materials§r$(br)Such as §bNether Stars§r and §bDiamonds§r. They don't target specific affixes but directly add extra enchantment power to the item.$(br2)§l2. Directed Materials§r$(br)Such as §bBlaze Rods§r and §bPoisonous Potatoes§r. They grant a fixed probability for certain affixes.

pages.title: §5Nether Star §r- Universal
pages.text: §5Nether Stars§r provide +15 enchantment power.$(br2)§7Guarantees affix level ≥3§r — levels below 3 are cleared and redistributed to higher levels.

pages.title: §bDiamond §r- Universal
pages.text: §bDiamonds§r provide +5 enchantment power.$(br2)§7Default max level cap: 5§r — levels above 5 are cleared and redistributed.
